;Disasters and accidents
*A national emergency is declared in the [[Philippines]] after more than 100,000 people contract [[dengue fever]]. [https://www.foxnews.com/world/philippines-national-emergency-dengue-fever (Fox News)]

;Health and environment
*[[2018–20 Kivu Ebola epidemic]]
**The [[World Health Organisation]] declares the most recent [[Ebola]] outbreak in the eastern [[Democratic Republic of the Congo]] a [[Public Health Emergency of International Concern]]. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2019/jul/17/drc-ebola-epidemic-is-international-emergency-says-who (''The Guardian'')]

;International relations
*[[Turkey–United States relations]]
**The [[United States]] removes [[NATO]] ally [[Turkey]] from the [[Joint Strike Fighter program]], following the country's acquisition of the [[Russia]]n [[S-400 missile system]]. Turkey had planned to buy 100 [[Lockheed Martin F-35 Lightning II|F-35 Lightning II]] jets. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-us-canada-49023115 (BBC News)]

;Law and crime
*[[AMIA bombing]]
**At the request of Israel and the United States, Argentina [[List of designated terrorist groups|officially declares]] [[Hezbollah]] a terrorist organization, freezing assets and expelling all members of the organization from the country. It also holds it responsible for the [[AMIA bombing|1994 attack against AMIA]]. [https://www.clarin.com/politica/gobierno-oficializa-decreto-hezbollah-considerado-grupo-terrorista-argentina_0_eWTtCRypT.html (''Clarín'')] [https://www.perfil.com/noticias/politica/amia-aumentan-indemnizaciones-declaran-terroristas-hezbollah-habra-duelo-nacional-2019.phtml (''Perfil'')] [https://tn.com.ar/politica/el-gobierno-incluye-hezbollah-en-la-lista-de-organizaciones-terroristas_979023 (TN)]
*Mexican [[drug lord]] [[Joaquín "El Chapo" Guzmán]] is sentenced to life in prison plus thirty years, and is ordered to forfeit US$12.6 billion. He accused the U.S. government of "torture and corruption" during his sentencing hearing in the U.S. District Court in Brooklyn, New York. He will likely be sent to [[ADX Florence]] in Colorado to serve his sentence. [https://www.cnbc.com/2019/07/17/drug-kingpin-el-chapo-sentenced-to-life-in-prison.html (CNBC)]
*[[Pakistan]] arrests [[Hafiz Saeed]], the founder of [[Lashkar-e-Taiba]], which has been blamed by the [[United States]] and [[India]] for the [[2008 Mumbai attacks|2008 Mumbai terror attacks]] that left more than 160 people dead. [https://www.cbsnews.com/news/pakistan-arrest-hafiz-saeed-terror-suspect-lashkar-e-taiba-imran-khan-meeting-donald-trump-washington-2019-07-17/ (CBS News)]
*A shooting in [[Erbil]], [[Iraqi Kurdistan]], leaves two dead, including a [[Turkey|Turkish]] diplomat. [https://www.dw.com/en/turkish-diplomat-killed-in-iraqs-kurdish-capital-irbil/a-49619981 (DW)]

;Politics and elections
*[[President of the European Commission|President-elect of the European Commission]] [[Ursula von der Leyen]] resigns from her position as [[Federal Ministry of Defence (Germany)|Federal Minister of Defence]] of [[Germany]]. [[Chancellor of Germany|Chancellor]] [[Angela Merkel]] appoints [[Annegret Kramp-Karrenbauer]], the leader of the ruling [[CDU (Germany)|CDU]], as her successor. [https://www.dw.com/en/leader-of-merkels-cdu-annegret-kramp-karrenbauer-to-become-german-defense-ministah/a-49613916-0 (DW)]
*[[2018–19 Sudanese protests]]
**Representatives of [[Sudan]]'s [[Sudanese military|military]] and the civil opposition sign the first of two parts of a power-sharing deal which is supposed to last until free elections in 2022. [https://www.dw.com/en/sudans-military-and-opposition-sign-first-part-of-power-sharing-deal/a-49615502 (DW)]
*The [[United States House of Representatives|U.S. House of Representatives]] votes 332–95 to [[Table (parliamentary procedure)|table]] an [[Impeachment in the United States|impeachment]]-related measure against [[President of the United States|U.S. President]] [[Donald Trump]]. [https://edition.cnn.com/2019/07/17/politics/trump-impeachment-house-vote/index.html (CNN)]
*<!--READ: Use the TALK PAGE to avoid edit warring. Major development in light of recent racial developments in the election-->During a [[Donald Trump 2020 presidential campaign|campaign rally]], [[President of the United States|U.S. President]] [[Donald Trump]] says [[The Squad (United States Congress)|"Squad" members]] "hate our country".  In light of [[Racial views of Donald Trump#Democratic Congresswomen should "go back" to their countries|recent statements made by Trump deemed as racist]], the crowd of Trump supporters started chanting "send her back" in regards to Representative [[Ilhan Omar]]. ;Science and technology
*[[Astronomer]]s rule out the chances of ~30-meter [[asteroid]] {{mpl|2006 QV|89}}'s impacting [[Earth]] in September 2019 by eliminating the possibility of its passing through an area where it would have to be if it were on an impacting orbit. Prior to this, the asteroid had been given a one-in-7,000 chance of impacting Earth. [https://phys.org/news/2019-07-esa-asteroid-earth.html (phys.org)]
